rules.summary: Explicit lookup syntax preserves ordered exact key and output mappings.

cases.name: overwrite composite key
cases.source: index=main | lookup service_catalog region AS event_region code AS status_code OUTPUT description AS status_description owner

cases.name: preserve existing output
cases.source: index=main | lookup service_catalog service_id AS service_key OUTPUTNEW owner tier team

cases.name: key mapping requires AS
cases.source: index=main | lookup service_catalog service_id service_key OUTPUT owner

cases.name: output mode is required
cases.source: index=main | lookup service_catalog service_id AS service_key

rules.summary: Lookup key and output cardinality is rejected before execution when it exceeds the compatibility boundary.

cases.name: fifth key
cases.source: index=main | lookup catalog k1 AS e1 k2 AS e2 k3 AS e3 k4 AS e4 k5 AS e5 OUTPUT owner

cases.name: seventeenth output
cases.source: index=main | lookup catalog id AS event_id OUTPUT o1 o2 o3 o4 o5 o6 o7 o8 o9 o10 o11 o12 o13 o14 o15 o16 o17
